x: 'Coggie' ran well - but not quite well enough. He took Belgrave into a 31 second lead but as Roger Alsop stormed away one couldn't help thinking that it was not going to be sufficient.

Coggie himself is gradually getting into shape again, running shorter distances for the time being, but still dreaming of Al Stewart’s offer to eat Coggie’s racing shorts should he ever fly back to a Belgrave ‘A’ team place at Sutton Park!
Coggie and TVH vest Our old mate Paul Coughlan in New Zealand wrote to let us know that a member of his club Olympic Harriers was approaching his 50th year of membership.
